findings.statement: All 28 attempts are classified once; runner policy labels, harness censoring, and the mixed transport attempt remain distinct, and the three challenged attribution controls have passing frozen adversarial-test receipts.

Four retries and both retry-after-terminal deviations remain explicit in reliability and cost; no retry yields an oracle-PASS quality selection, earliest eligible selection is enforced, and mutation tests reject terminal erasure and best-of-N behavior.

Recovery-affected material is excluded from component gaps and comparative ranking; every frozen classification records recovery_used=false, while the unresolved harness-censored slot is denied supplemental authorization.

The input freeze forbids original-budget mutation, retry accounting reports no post-hoc expansion, and the separate supplemental budget is immutable, source-budget-preserving, not authorized, and capped at zero starts.
The attribution summary and every automated decision record identity_used=false, arm identity is explicitly excluded evidence, and only anonymous arm IDs occur in the audited records.
All decision wrappers record majority_vote_used=false and human_technical_gate_used=false; embedded judge_decisions are empty and predecessor outputs are retained as evidence rather than votes.

Favorable retry and protocol booleans are not accepted on assertion alone: the frozen receipt records passing deletion, best-of-N, zero-imputation, cost-preserving, protocol-drift, and missing-precondition adversarial tests.

Quality remains insufficient at two balanced cases and quality repeat depth one, whereas reliability is accepted only as descriptive observed-cohort evidence; quality and performance-superiority claims remain prohibited.
No post-hoc performance or architecture-superiority claim is allowed; architecture and base selection are rejected, while repeated gaps support only specification-level component work.

Supplemental authorization rejects generic and terminal-slot retries, authorizes no slots, freezes a zero-start budget, and records a launch-locked zero-start receipt because harness equivalence is not established.

Every automated decision routes only to PHASE-EVIDENCE-EXPANSION-002D; architecture and quality decisions reject PHASE_003 and require a newly frozen acquisition design to close the balanced-case and quality-repeat gaps.

DECISION-RELIABILITY-EVIDENCE-SUFFICIENCY-002D-R1 is internally inconsistent: the wrapper accepted_scope is RELIABILITY_ONLY while automated_decision.accepted_scope is NONE; all other decision wrappers agree with their embedded value.

The frozen decisions are hash-bound, but five-variant replay readiness is not established while the reliability decision exposes two different accepted scopes; variant consumers can branch differently before any evidence changes.

normalization: Verbatim finding statements and verdict projection retained by the main agent; full native schema output is superseded only after a hash-bound repair audit.
